subject: math
description: Plot the center and radius lengths of a circle from center-radius form, then use those points to sketch an accurate circle graph.
learningObjectives: Identify the center and radius from center-radius form
Plot the center of a circle on the coordinate plane
Use the radius to locate points above, below, left, and right of the center
Sketch an accurate circle graph from an equation
Check whether a graph matches its center and radius
